spec.title: NEXT temporary cross-cutting contract — Deferred work

p.NEXT-G13-SCOPE: Frozen cross-cutting requirement source from refined plan revision 4 section 13. It complements domain contracts and must be promoted clause by clause; no product implementation or completion is asserted here.
